scope: Entrance image payload only; excludes JavaScript, styles, fonts and the rest of the lobby.

encoding.source: Original PNG artwork, validated sprite crops, original dimensions

delivery.fighters: AVIF selected by picture, WebP fallback, content-hashed filenames cached for one year
delivery.background: Explicit AVIF Accept support selects AVIF at the same /assets/caracas.webp URL used by the lobby and game; Vary: Accept; WebP fallback; ETag validation
delivery.limitations: Local production server, Chromium, desktop viewport. Transfer sizes demonstrate bytes and cache behavior, not latency on a physical mobile network.

verification: Compared compressed artwork side by side with the source at rendered scale.
Production cache, Accept negotiation, q=0, conditional 304 and missing AVIF fallback covered by tests/performance.test.ts.
Existing security tests and production build pass.
